title: German Chicken Pie
description: A twist on the classic British chicken pie, with a German-inspired mash topping.
instructions: Season the chicken with salt and pepper.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the flour to the skillet and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Gradually add the milk, whisking continuously.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 2-3 minutes.
Roll out the pie crust and place it in a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Fill the pie crust with the chicken mixture and cover with mashed potatoes.
Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, or until the potatoes are golden brown.
